text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 206SP-JPSTD1 Single Cylinder Jimmy Proof Locks

Jimmy proof apartment locks, aka New York City Apartment Locks, because of their wide uses on front apartment doors in the big apple. They prevent the door from being "Jimmied" open (pried open) with a crow bar by securely locking your door to the door frame.

Also available: Jimmy Proof Lock without a exterior lock cylinder.

High security surface mounted deadlock protection combined together with a MUL-T-LOCK exterior high security lock cylinder. Locks by restricted key cylinder outside and thumb turn inside. Supplied with two (2) keys, owner key card and matching finish mounting screws in your choice of Bright Brass or Bright Chrome finish.

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock 206SP-JPSTD1 Jimmy Proof Lock

  • UL437 Drill and Pick Resistance
  • Bump Proof Lock Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206SP Security Keyway
  • 2 Mul-T-Lock Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Width: 4.49"
  • Height: 2.87"
  • Depth: 1.18"
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S-JPSTD1 Specifications Diagram (PDF)
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

MUL-T-LOCK's locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.
